objective: Construct paired box plots from ordered data and interpret IQR as middle-half spread, including cases where range and IQR lead to different comparisons.

learning_sequence.learner_action: Arrange two sets of eight measurement cards and notice shared center, extreme values and the densest middle region without calculating.
Predict which middle half is more spread and separately predict which complete set has the larger range.
Partition each ordered set into equal lower and upper halves, place min/Q1/median/Q3/max markers and construct the box and whiskers.
Explain why box width is Q3 minus Q1 and why moving only an extreme can change range without changing IQR.
Complete fresh five-number summaries, box-plot coordinates and paired spread comparisons using the declared eight-value quartile convention.
Route submitted quartiles, IQRs and comparison choice to a response-evidence repair, then pass a new-data exit check before scaffolds fade.
Compare two unfamiliar sensor runs having equal medians but conflicting range and IQR order; recommend the more consistent middle half and defend the statistic selected.
Submit both five-number summaries, both IQRs, two comparison decisions and a range-versus-IQR explanation on a hidden fresh variant without hints or plot readouts.

quartile_convention: For exactly eight sorted observations, median is the mean of positions 4 and 5; Q1 and Q3 are the medians of the four-value lower and upper halves.

diagnostic_router.observed_evidence: Both submitted IQRs equal maximum minus minimum.
socratic_questions: Which observations lie outside that box?
What subtraction measures only the box width?
diagnostic_router.repair: Cover the whiskers, calculate Q3 minus Q1, then reveal the extremes and contrast the two measures.
diagnostic_router.exit_check: Change one extreme only and explain which measure changes.

diagnostic_router.observed_evidence: The learner chooses the set with larger range even though its IQR is smaller.
socratic_questions: Does the question ask about every reading or the middle half?
Which visual length represents the middle half?
Can long whiskers coexist with a short box?
diagnostic_router.repair: Compare box widths before whiskers and state the population portion represented by each.
diagnostic_router.exit_check: Choose the more consistent middle half in a new conflicting range/IQR pair.

diagnostic_router.observed_evidence: A submitted IQR is negative or Q1 is placed to the right of Q3.
socratic_questions: Where is the lower half on the ordered line?
What direction should a distance subtraction use?
diagnostic_router.repair: Reorder values and label lower/upper halves before calculating either quartile.
diagnostic_router.exit_check: Place Q1 and Q3 for a different eight-value set and compute a nonnegative width.

diagnostic_router.observed_evidence: The comparison choice is correct but one or both exact IQR values are not.
socratic_questions: Which four values form each half?
What are the two middle positions in that half?
Does your box endpoint match your quartile value?
diagnostic_router.repair: Link each quartile marker to its two source observations, then recompute the box width.
diagnostic_router.exit_check: Reconstruct a five-number summary from new raw data.

accessibility_contract.keyboard_only: Move through the ordered data table, assign quartile markers and compare plots with native controls; dragging is optional.
accessibility_contract.screen_reader_state: Announce ordered values, marker label and value, completed five-number summary, box interval and whisker intervals without announcing calculated answers in assessment.
accessibility_contract.nonvisual_equivalent: Two tables expose ordered observations and learner-entered min/Q1/median/Q3/max; a comparison table records IQR and range claims.
accessibility_contract.focus_recovery: Preserve all entries and return focus to the first inconsistent quartile or comparison field with a concise reason.
accessibility_contract.reduced_motion: Use discrete before/after plot states; no animation is required to interpret spread.
